quote: indicated for the treatment of mild to moderate dementia of the Alzheimer's type
note: Galantamine (benzgalantamine active moiety) labels name Alzheimer dementia.

quote: relief of bronchospasm in patients 2 to 12 years of age with asthma (reversible obstructive airway disease)
note: Bronchospasm relief in asthma is management of asthma itself.

quote: insomnia or hypersomnia
note: Insomnia appears only as a listed symptom of MDD (and in warnings); drug treats depression.

quote: PELVIC INFLAMMATORY DISEASE caused by Neisseria gonorrhoeae.
note: PID listed as an indicated infection.

quote: treatment of allergic symptoms by immunotherapy in patients with a history of grass pollen allergy
note: Grass pollen allergy immunotherapy covers seasonal allergic rhinitis; not named verbatim.

quote: Gastrointestinal Infections caused by Salmonella typhi (typhoid fever)
note: Typhoid fever explicitly listed.

quote: Keratitis Optic neuritis Allergic conjunctivitis
note: Optic neuritis named in ophthalmic disease list.

quote: help restore normal serum potassium levels in patients who develop hypokalemia
note: Hypokalemia (potassium deficiency) treatment/prevention is the indication.

quote: For the treatment of dermatomyositis, polymyositis, and systemic lupus erythematosus.
note: Juvenile dermatomyositis is a subtype of indicated dermatomyositis.

quote: treatment of pediatric patients 1 year of age and older with low-grade glioma (LGG) with a BRAF V600E mutation
note: LGG is a glioma; edge is a near parent.

quote: Serum sickness. Allergic conjunctivitis.
note: Atopic conjunctivitis is a form of indicated allergic conjunctivitis.

quote: treatment of secondary hyperparathyroidism (HPT) in adult patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) on hemodialysis
note: CKD is the population; target is secondary HPT.

quote: indicated for the prophylaxis of vomiting associated with emetogenic cancer chemotherapy
note: Vomiting prevention is explicitly indicated.

quote: pathological hypersecretory conditions (i.e., Zollinger-Ellison Syndrome, systemic mastocytosis, multiple endocrine adenomas)
note: Systemic mastocytosis named in list of indicated conditions.

quote: To improve hemodynamic status in patients in distributive shock and shock due to reduced cardiac output
note: Shock due to reduced cardiac output is cardiogenic shock.

quote: indicated for the treatment of adult patients with unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma (uHCC)
note: HCC explicitly indicated.

quote: increased fatigue
note: Fatigue appears only as a symptom in the MDD definition; drug treats depression.

quote: Aspergillosis, pulmonary and extrapulmonary, in patients who are intolerant of or who are refractory to amphotericin B therapy.
note: Aspergillosis explicitly indicated.

quote: to control the development of renal bone disease
note: EMA text frames use within multi-therapy approach to control renal bone disease; primary target is hyperphosphataemia.

quote: anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK)-positive metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC)
note: NSCLC explicitly indicated.

quote: management of pain severe enough to require an opioid analgesic and for which alternative treatments are inadequate
note: Generic severe pain indication; mastalgia is a narrower pain subtype, not named.

quote: in adults with hypercholesterolemia, including heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH)
note: HeFH explicitly named.

quote: Social Anxiety Disorder (SAD), also known as social phobia
note: Social phobia is a phobic disorder; panic with agoraphobia also listed.

quote: short stature associated with Noonan syndrome
note: Label treats short stature in Noonan syndrome, not the syndrome itself.

quote: relapsed or refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified (DLBCL, NOS)
note: DLBCL explicitly indicated.

quote: adenocarcinoma of the ovary
note: Cyclophosphamide (parent of 4-hydroxy metabolite) labels list ovarian adenocarcinoma.

quote: treatment of adult patients with chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) or small lymphocytic lymphoma (SLL)
note: CLL explicitly indicated.

quote: maintenance treatment of bronchospasm associated with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), including chronic bronchitis and emphysema
note: Chronic bronchitis named as included COPD form.

quote: gBRCA m, HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer
note: Metastatic (stage IV) breast cancer explicitly indicated.

quote: indicated for the treatment of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD)
note: Inattentive type is a subtype of indicated ADHD.

quote: Treatment of adult and pediatric patients with acute lymphoblastic leukemia as part of a combination chemotherapy regimen
note: ALL is a lymphoid leukemia; edge is a near parent.

quote: Vemlidy is indicated for the treatment of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) in adults and paediatric patients
note: CHB explicitly indicated in EMA text.

quote: treatment of inflammatory papules and pustules of rosacea
note: Pustules are directly the treated lesion (of rosacea).

quote: Synovitis of osteoarthritis Rheumatoid arthritis Acute and subacute bursitis Acute gouty arthritis
note: Multiple arthritides listed; edge is a near parent.

quote: Diabetic Macular Edema (DME)
note: DME explicitly indicated.

quote: transfusional iron overload in adult and pediatric patients 3 years of age and older with thalassemia syndromes, sickle cell disease or other anemias
note: Anemia is the background population; target is iron overload.

quote: documented ventricular arrhythmias, such as sustained ventricular tachycardia, that, in the judgment of the physician, are life-threatening
note: Ventricular tachycardia is a tachycardia; edge is a near parent.

quote: treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic colorectal cancer
note: Metastatic colon cancer covered.

quote: Treatment of active duodenal ulcer in adults
note: Duodenal ulcer explicitly indicated.

quote: treatment or prevention of bronchospasm in adults, adolescents, and children 6 years of age and older with reversible obstructive airway disease
note: Reversible obstructive airway disease is a standard synonym for asthma.

quote: indicated for the treatment of deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and pulmonary embolism (PE)
note: PE and systemic embolism are treated/prevented.

quote: Celecoxib Capsules is indicated for relief of the signs and symptoms of OA
note: OA explicitly indicated.

quote: hereditary transthyretin-mediated amyloidosis (hATTR amyloidosis) in adult patients with stage 1 or stage 2 polyneuropathy
note: Polyneuropathy is the patient population/stage; target is hATTR amyloidosis.

quote: Secondary Hyperparathyroidism (HPT) in adult patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) on dialysis
note: Renal failure is the setting; target is secondary HPT.

quote: Whether a negative skin test to PRE-PEN predicts a lower risk of anaphylaxis is not established.
note: Diagnostic skin test; anaphylaxis mentioned only in a not-established statement.
